_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_dynamics#2 — on the upstream beam3r_herm2line3_genalpha_liegroup_lineload_dynamic deck (MAXTIME shortened to 0.05, RESULT DESCRIPTION removed so the control arm can exit 0), the GenAlphaLieGroup + MASSLIN rotations pairing is enforced in both directions but very unevenly.
